setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

starting_state: Channel 1 loops C, D, E on pattern 1, steps 1–3, through a MIDI device at 90 BPM and Rate /9. Song mode is On and the selected slot lasts 64 global steps. Reset on song seq change and Reset on pattern repeat are Off. Playback is stopped, and PARAMS is open on the repeat-reset option.

steps.caption: Independent starting point: channel 1 loops C, D, E over steps 1–3 at Rate /9 and 90 BPM, so a channel step lasts 1.5 seconds. Song mode is On; the slot lasts 64 global sixteenth-note steps. Reset on song seq change is Off. The selected Reset on pattern repeat row reads Off: the slow line keeps its place when this slot repeats.
steps.title: Reset on pattern repeat Off

steps.caption: Play through the first slot repeat. With repeat reset Off, D3 sounds at 10.5 seconds, and the channel continues its own three-note cycle. There is no new C3 at the slot boundary, 10.667 seconds.
steps.title: Follow the slow channel through the first repeat

steps.caption: Turn Reset on pattern repeat On; the selected option row visibly reads On.
steps.title: Reset on pattern repeat On

steps.caption: Play the same comparison with repeat reset On. D3 still sounds at 10.5 seconds; at the 10.667-second slot boundary the channel restarts on C3. The extra C marks the reset, rather than a change to the channel’s /9 rate.
steps.title: Hear the normal note, then the repeat restart

title: Compare phase at the first song boundary
